name: The Rug Abides
description: A man named The Dude lost his Nuka-Cola-patterned rug to a trio of Nihilists holed up in the pre-war Bowl-O-Rama. He just wants it back. It really tied the shelter together.
lore: Before the war, bowling alleys were temples of blue-collar leisure. The Bowl-O-Rama south of the Mojave Outpost was one of the last to close. Three self-described Nihilists now occupy it as a base — not because it's strategic, but because it proves nothing matters. The Dude disagrees. The rug matters.

objectives.description: Locate the Bowl-O-Rama south of the Mojave Outpost
Deal with the Nihilists — through diplomacy, intimidation, or caps. They believe in nothing, so threaten or buy them out of it.
Return the rug to The Dude

endings.description: You returned the rug. The Dude abides. The shelter is complete again.
endings.reward: The Dude's Blessing: +5% Caps from all trades for 24 hours
endings.consequence: The Dude sets up a small trade post and occasionally leaves Nuka-Cola bottles at rest spots across the Mojave.

endings.description: You kept the rug for yourself. It really does tie the shelter together.
endings.reward: The Dude's Rug (home decoration, +morale stat when in shelter)
endings.consequence: The Dude sighs, says 'Yeah, well... that's just like, your opinion, man,' and wanders off east.

endings.description: You sold the rug to a pre-war collector.
endings.consequence: The Dude says he's not even angry. He's sad. He says it a lot of times. It doesn't seem true.
